63130-mr-meek-plays-polo.title: Mr Meek Plays Polo
63130-mr-meek-plays-polo.creator: Unknown
63130-mr-meek-plays-polo.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Two ships now were on the field, pulled up close against the repair shop. One, Meek noticed, belonged to the Solar Health and Welfare Department, the other to the Galactic Pharmaceutical Corporation. The Galactic ship was a freighter, ponderous and slow. It was here, Meek knew, to take on a cargo of radiation moss. But the other was a puzzler.

arxiv-2203-10328.title: Funnel MPC with feasibility constraints for nonlinear systems with arbitrary relative degree*
arxiv-2203-10328.creator: Thomas Berger, Dario Dennstädt
arxiv-2203-10328.description: Abstract We study tracking control for nonlinear systems with known relative degree and stable internal dynamics by the recently introduced technique of Funnel MPC. The objective is to achieve the evolution of the tracking error within a prescribed performance funnel.

arxiv-2212-06974.title: The Effectiveness of a Simple Helmholtz coil-like Magnetic Shield at Reducing X-ray-like Background in Space-based X-ray Detectors
arxiv-2212-06974.creator: Dr. Christopher S. W. Davis, Dr David Hall
arxiv-2212-06974.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dr. Christopher S. W. Davis, Dr David Hall. Both active and passive magnetic shielding have been used extensively during past and current X-ray astronomy missions to shield detectors from soft protons and electrons entering through telescope optics. However, simulations performed throughout the past decade have discovered that a significant proportion of X-ray-like background originates from secondary electrons produced in spacecraft shielding surrounding X-ray detectors, which hit detectors isotropically from all directions.

arxiv-2305-01839.title: Multivariate Symmetry: Distribution-Free Testing via Optimal Transport
arxiv-2305-01839.creator: Zhen Huang Department of Statistics, Columbia University e-mail: zh2395@columbia.edu and Bodhisattva Sen Department of Statistics, Columbia University e-mail: bodhi@stat.columbia.edu
arxiv-2305-01839.description: Abstract The sign test (Arbuthnott, 1710) and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test (Wilcoxon, 1945) are among the first examples of a nonparametric test. These procedures — based on signs, (absolute) ranks and signed-ranks — yield distribution-free tests for symmetry in one-dimension.

arxiv-2305-11863.title: Scaling laws for language encoding models in fMRI
arxiv-2305-11863.creator: Richard J. Antonello, Aditya R. Vaidya, Alexander G. Huth
arxiv-2305-11863.description: Abstract Representations from transformer-based unidirectional language models are known to be effective at predicting brain responses to natural language. However, most studies comparing language models to brains have used GPT-2 or similarly sized language models. Here we tested whether larger open-source models such as those from the OPT and LLaMA families are better at predicting brain responses recorded using fMRI.

arxiv-2309-10161.title: Biexact von Neumann algebras
arxiv-2309-10161.creator: Changying Ding, Jesse Peterson
arxiv-2309-10161.description: Abstract . We introduce the notion of biexactness for general von Neumann algebras, naturally extending the notion from group theory. We show that biexactness implies solidity for von Neumann algebras, and that many of the examples of solid von Neumann algebras contained in the literature are, in fact, biexact.

arxiv-2311-01641.title: Joint Queue-Length Distribution for the Non-Preemptive Multi-Server Multi-Level Markovian Priority Queue
arxiv-2311-01641.creator: Josef Zuk, David Kirszenblat
arxiv-2311-01641.description: Abstract Explicit results are obtained using simple and exact methods for the joint queue-length distribution of the M/M/ c c queue with an arbitrary number of non-preemptive priority levels. This work is the first to provide explicit results for the joint probability generating function and joint probability mass function for a general number of priority levels.

arxiv-2401-02709.title: German Text Embedding Clustering Benchmark
arxiv-2401-02709.creator: Silvan Wehrli, Bert Arnrich, Christopher Irrgang
arxiv-2401-02709.description: Abstract This work introduces a benchmark assessing the performance of clustering German text embeddings in different domains. This benchmark is driven by the increasing use of clustering neural text embeddings in tasks that require the grouping of texts (such as topic modeling) and the need for German resources in existing benchmarks.

arxiv-2602-08430.title: Understanding and Optimizing Attention-Based Sparse Matching for Diverse Local Features
arxiv-2602-08430.creator: Qiang Wang
arxiv-2602-08430.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Qiang Wang. We revisit the problem of training attention-based sparse image matching models for various local features. We first identify one critical design choice that has been previously overlooked, which significantly impacts the performance of the LightGlue model. We then investigate the role of detectors and descriptors within the transformer-based matching framework, finding that detectors, rather than descriptors, are often the primary cause for performance difference.

britannica-1911-north-west-frontier-prov.description: Article 'North-West Frontier Province' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 19), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE, the most northerly province of British India, created on the 25th of October 1901. Roughly it may be defined as the tract of country N. of Baluchistan, lying between the Indus and Afghanistan.

pmc-10541409.title: Personalization and localization as key expectations of digital health intervention in women pre- to post-pregnancy
pmc-10541409.creator: V Vien Lee, Smrithi Vijayakumar, Wei Ying Ng, Ni Yin Lau, Qiao Ying Leong, Delicia Shu Qin Ooi, Lin Lin Su, Yung Seng Lee, Shiao-Yng Chan, Agata Blasiak, Dean Ho
pmc-10541409.description: Health behaviors before, during and after pregnancy can have lasting effects on maternal and infant health outcomes. Although digital health interventions (DHIs) have potential as a pertinent avenue to deliver mechanisms for a healthy behavior change, its success is reliant on addressing the user needs.

pmc-11481274.title: The non-inferiority of piperonyl-butoxide Yorkool® G3 insecticide-treated nets compared to Olyset®Plus measured by Anopheles arabiensis mortality in experimental huts in Tanzania
pmc-11481274.creator: Olukayode G. Odufuwa, Masudi Suleiman Maasayi, Emmanuel Mbuba, Watson Ntabaliba, Rose Philipo, Safina Ngonyani, Ahmadi Bakari Mpelepele, Isaya Matanila, Hassan Ngonyani, Jason Moore, Yeromin P. Mlacha, Jennifer C. Stevenson, Sarah Jane Moore
pmc-11481274.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundNon-inferiority trials are recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO) to demonstrate that health products show comparable efficacy to that of existing standard of care. As part of the WHO Global Malaria Programme (GMP) process of assessment of malaria vector control products, a second-in-class insecticide-treated net (ITN) must be shown to be non-inferior to a first-in-class product based on mosquito mortality.

pmc-11565284.title: Electrochemical Reduction of Nitrogen to Ammonia Using Zinc Telluride
pmc-11565284.creator: Sham J. Mane, Nesta B. Joseph, Rekha Kumari, Awadhesh Narayan, Aninda J. Bhattacharyya
pmc-11565284.description: Electrosynthesis of ammonia (NH3), an important constituent molecule of various commercial fertilizers, is a promising and sustainable alternative strategy compared with the century-old Haber-Bosch process. Herein, zinc telluride (ZnTe) is demonstrated as an efficient electrocatalyst for reducing nitrogen (N2) under ambient conditions to NH3.

pmc-12649316.title: Genotypic Characterization of Virulence Factors in Extended-Spectrum Beta-Lactamase (ESBL)-Producing Escherichia coli Strains from Chickens in Hungary
pmc-12649316.creator: Ádám Kerek, Ábel Szabó, Gergely Tornyos, Eszter Kaszab, Krisztina Bali, Ákos Jerzsele, Linzy Elton
pmc-12649316.description: Background: The increasing attention on extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing Escherichia coli strains isolated from poultry flocks stems from concerns about their virulence potential and zoonotic risk. Of particular significance is the identification of extraintestinal pathogenic E. coli (ExPEC) pathotypes in poultry, as these strains pose not only animal health concerns but also serious threats to food safety and public health.

pmc-12830848.title: Determinants of sensitivity to HER2-targeted antibody drug conjugates in urothelial cancer
pmc-12830848.creator: Ziyu Chen, Xinran Tang, Jordan E. Eichholz, Andrew Mcpherson, Jasmine Thomas, Karan Nagar, Naryan Rustgi, John R. Christin, Fengshen Kuo, Sizhi Gao, Hui Jiang, Jiaqian Luo, Irina Ostrovnaya, Merve Basar, Eugene Pietzak, Jonathan A. Coleman, Michael F. Berger, Elisa de Stanchina, Sohrab P. Shah, Neem
pmc-12830848.description: HER2, encoded by the ERBB2 gene, is a receptor tyrosine kinase frequently activated in human cancers via gene amplification, mutation, and/or protein overexpression. In an analysis of 42,415 prospectively analyzed solid tumors, we show that 14.5% of urothelial cancers (n = 295/2,035) have oncogenic or likely oncogenic ERBB2 alterations (6.7% ERBB2 mutation, 6.3% amplification of wildtype ERBB2, and 1.

pmc-13338787.title: Quantitative Aortic Arch Calcification Is Associated with Non-ipsilateral Ischemic Lesions after Transfemoral Carotid Artery Stenting
pmc-13338787.creator: Koji SHIMONAGA, Yoshito HIRATA, Masakazu MITSUNOBU, Ryo OGAMI, Yoshihiro KIURA, Atsushi TOMINAGA, Nobutaka HORIE
pmc-13338787.description: Non-ipsilateral ischemic lesions after carotid artery stenting are considered to arise from emboli originating in the aortic arch, but the quantitative contribution of aortic arch calcification to post-carotid artery stenting ischemic lesions remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the association between volumetric aortic arch calcification and non-ipsilateral diffusion-weighted imaging hyperintense lesions after transfemoral carotid artery stenting.

pmc-13392941.title: A yeast-based oral vaccine platform reveals antigen-dependent protection against Eimeria tenella
pmc-13392941.creator: Wenqi Han, Lang Chen, Lu Wang, Qiping Zhao, Shunhai Zhu, Yu Yu, Jiayu Bai, Hongyu Han, Lili Hao, Hui Dong
pmc-13392941.description: The development of effective oral mucosal vaccines against intracellular enteric pathogens remains a formidable hurdle, demanding innovative platforms that combine targeted antigen delivery with the induction of potent local immunity. Avian coccidiosis, caused by Eimeria parasites, exemplifies this need, as its control is hampered by drug resistance and limitations of live vaccines.

pmc-13536394.title: Late implant loss and complications of one-step implant therapy in severely atrophic posterior maxilla
pmc-13536394.creator: Shing-Zeng Dung, Jui Wang, Yung-Ting Hsu, Tzu-Hsuan Weng, Shale M. Ninneman, Yu-Kang Tu
pmc-13536394.description: Background/purposeSuccessful long-term outcomes of one-step implant placement in the atrophic maxilla have rarely been reported. This retrospective study aimed to evaluate the long-term efficacy of the one-step lateral sinus floor elevation and simultaneous implant placement (LSFESI) in severely atrophic posterior maxilla, and to identify the risk factors for marginal bone loss (MBL) and late implant failure (LIF).

pmc-13673738.title: From dysconnectivity to symptoms: large-scale resting-state networks relate to psychotic phenomenology in schizophrenia
pmc-13673738.creator: Ting Yu, Shaokun Zhao, Yanli Li, Na Li, MengZhuang Gou, WenJin Chen, XiaoYing Wang, JingHui Tong, Yunlong Tan
pmc-13673738.description: BackgroundSchizophrenia is increasingly conceptualized as a disorder of large-scale brain network integration, yet how specific symptom phenotypes relate to reproducible resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) signatures remains unclear.MethodsResting-state fMRI data from 386 patients with schizophrenia and 212 healthy controls were analyzed to characterize large-scale functional connectivity patterns.
